portable.method: Portable sufficient-statistic reproduction, not an independent raw-archive or semantic validation.

document.limitation: Automated document checks complement, not replace, page-by-page visual inspection.

original_sources_optional.scope: Entire original listed file hashes plus selected record equality; not an independent semantic assessment.

visual_review: All 16 pages rendered; figures revised for label spacing. Final figure-containing pages rechecked.
clean_build: Only delivered source/data/styles and installed TeX/Python dependencies; PYTHONPATH cleared and user-site imports disabled. No pcc imports or private artifact access. PDF and figure byte identity checked against in-place build.
historical_work: No files outside paper_submission changed by this task.
scientific_limit: Software, source and packaging checks are not semantic or causal validation.

controlled.qualification: Typed matches and observed plans; no new semantic or causal interpretation.

whitespace_check: Authored TeX, Markdown, JSON, shell and Python pass. Whole-package diff-check flags original CRLF/trailing whitespace in unmodified official template and copied CSV sources; original bytes deliberately preserved.
compact_outcomes: One JSON object per observation; decoded objects exactly equal to the clean-build-verified snapshot.
